bug_description: The Id field is missing in the mapping from GenreDto to Genre, which may cause issues in entity identification.
problem_statement:
## Bug: Missing Genre Identification in Music Collection

### Description
We have encountered an issue in the kollector-scum application where users are experiencing unexpected behavior when viewing their music collections. Specifically, it appears that when users attempt to list genres within their collection, the application is failing to properly identify certain genres. As a result, users may see unexpected data appearing in their collections, which could lead to confusion regarding the genres associated with their owned music.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Log in to the kollector-scum application with a user account that has a music collection.
2. Navigate to the "Genres" section of your collection.
3. Observe the list of genres displayed. In some cases, users may find that genres are incorrectly represented or that duplicate entries appear for the same genre.

### Impact
This bug can significantly affect the user experience, as users may not be able to accurately identify or manage the genres in their collections. Moreover, the presence of incorrect or duplicate genres can lead to frustration when users attempt to organize their music, potentially impacting their interactions with the platform.

We need to investigate this issue further to ensure that genre identification is functioning as intended and to prevent any data inconsistency that might confuse our users. Please prioritize this for our next sprint, as it directly affects the usability of our multi-tenant service.
